correctness.rationale: Write f=xg²+h² with g=x²+ux+v, h=wx+z; smooth iff gcd(g,h)=1. Riemann–Hurwitz gives genus four; the four differentials dx/y, dx/y², xdx/y², x²dx/y² have distinct nonnegative pole valuations. Semilinear Cartier sends ω0 to ω3+uω2+vω1, ω2 to ω0, others to zero, hence rank exactly 2, a=2, and stable rank 0 iff u=0. Count polynomial coprimality over any q=2^m directly. For q=4 independent exact GF(4^j), j=1..4, curve point counts and Weil polynomial Newton hull across all 192 smooth coefficient quadruples reproduced 48/144 NP split and 15/51 distinct polynomials. Finite enumeration establishes ONLY the stated F4 obstruction, not NP for all rank-zero parameters over all fields.
